mechanics.claim: Dragon's Descent has no cooldown; it is gated purely by a Fury resource that must reach 100 to cast, and is spent at a recurring rate of ~3.33 per 0.5s while in Dragon Form.
Shyvana gains 100 Fury immediately upon learning the ability, so it can be cast right away on level-up.
mechanics.quote: '''Shyvana''' gains {{as|100 Dragon Fury}} upon learning ''Dragon's Descent''.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and abilities generate Fury per enemy damaged, once per enemy per cast instance, and this generation is tripled while already in Dragon Form; against non-champions this generation from abilities is reduced to 25%.
Shyvana's Q (Emberstrike) basic attack against the primary target generates the full Fury amount even against non-champions, unlike other abilities/attacks against non-champions.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ais|Emberstrike|Shyvana}}'' attack against the primary target will generate the full {{as|Dragon Fury}} amount even if they're a non-champion.

mechanics.claim: Shyvana gains 1% bonus Fury generation from all sources per 1 ultimate haste, increasing her effective uptime and cast frequency of this ability.
mechanics.quote: '''Shyvana''' gains 1% '''bonus''' {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation from all sources per 1 [[ultimate haste]].

mechanics.claim: Displacement immunity during the dash begins at the start of the cast time, not when the dash itself begins.
mechanics.quote: ''Dragon's Descent's'' {{tip|displacement immunity}} begins from the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Entering Dragon Form empowers Shyvana's basic abilities (Q/W/E) to apply an additional effect, which changes their damage output in Dragon Form (see Q/W/E dossier parts).
mechanics.quote: Her basic abilities are empowered to apply an additional effect.

mechanics.claim: Shyvana reverts to Human Form once all Dragon Fury has been depleted while in Dragon Form.
mechanics.quote: returning to {{sbc|Human Form}} once all {{as|Dragon Fury}} has been depleted.
